mainEntity.name: Can AI compare competitor prices without giving me misleading numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can summarize visible competitor pricing, but pricing pages often omit discounts, usage limits, onboarding costs, regional differences, or custom quotes. Treat every figure as evidence tied to a date and page, not as a permanent fact. Key factors include: - plan limits - included features - billing frequency - add-ons and implementation work. Ask the workflow to create an apples-to-apples comparison and mark missing information rather than estimating it. Use the result to understand positioning and customer tradeoffs, not to copy a competitor’s price automatically.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can collect and organize public pricing, but verify dates, plan limits, billing terms, add-ons, discounts, and custom-quote conditions. Ask for an apples-to-apples comparison and clear missing-data labels. Use pricing research to understand value and tradeoffs, not to copy a number blindly.
